title: OnboardingRecord
description: Durable onboarding progress for one Product; the bounded bootstrap record resumed by a restarted execution (checkpoint 006). Product lifecycle stays on the existing ProductState enum. `pinnedRevision` (full lowercase 40-hex), `workspace` (EITHER a per-execution WorkspaceDescriptor OR a product-scoped DurableWorkspaceDescriptor — the two are distinguished by the durable shape's constant `kind` discriminator and are never interchangeable) and `completedBaselineId` (the ProductBaseline whose human acceptance set `completed`) are OPTIONAL and are omitted when absent, because a Product is registered long before anything pins or completes it. They are deliberately not required: `completed` is a bare bool that the published store contract writes without completion evidence, and forbidding that weaker state in the contract would break a contract test to enforce an invariant nothing needs.

workspace.description: Exactly one of the two descriptor shapes. `oneOf`, not a permissive object: the two are disjoint (the durable branch requires `kind`, which the per-execution schema forbids, and both are `additionalProperties: false`), so exactly one branch matches a well-formed document and a document matching neither is refused. A reader that guesses which shape it was handed would be resolving a product's durable clone as a worker execution's worktree.

DurableWorkspaceDescriptor.description: Inlined copy of durable_workspace_descriptor.schema.json. Inlined rather than `$ref`-ed across files for the same reason WorkspaceDescriptor is inlined: this repository's schemas are each self-contained so one can be read, and conformance-tested, on its own.
